Subject: URGENT: Elevated latency / 5xx spikes — private VPC deployment

Hi Monica,

We're seeing a severe degradation on our private VPC deployment right now (FinCo-prod). Since ~03:00 UTC this morning we've observed sustained tail latency increases (p50 from ~50ms to ~350-450ms, p95 > 1.2s) and 5xx error spikes to ~7% of requests. Throughput has dropped by ~30% compared to our baseline. This is causing timeouts in our customer-facing flows and two enterprise customers opened complaints.

Attached are the logs and a perf dump (support_log_20260302.zip, perf_dump_20260302.pb). We've preserved the nodes and haven't restarted anything — want to keep traces intact.

We need Redwood on this immediately. Please escalate to engineering and execs if needed; this is materially impacting SLAs and revenue on our side. What are recommended immediate mitigations? If there's a safe hotfix/path we can apply ourselves in our private deployment, tell us what to run and we'll execute.

We also want a brief exec note to our CIO — please advise on timing for a call and an RCA.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering
FinCo

Immediate plan (0-3 hours):

I'll collect diagnostic outputs from Markus and confirm the short-term steps. Grace — please coordinate the customer comms and set expectations around SLA credits and an RCA timeline.

On Tue, Mar 2, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alicia Gomez <agomez@finco.com> wrote:
> We're seeing a severe degradation on our private VPC deployment right now...

Quick summary of initial findings from the logs Alicia shared:
- We see repeated stall traces in the inference runtime around KV cache flush and kernel handoff for long-sequence requests. The GPU queues are intermittently backing up and host-side OOM throttling is evident on one of the nodes.
- Error stack traces indicate a small subset of requests hit an unhandled path that escalates to a 500 (we're seeing ~6-8% of traffic).

Short-term mitigations (recommended, low-risk):
1) Scale pool: increase node count from 4 -> 6 (add 2 identical instance types). This reduces per-node load and gives immediate breathing room.
   - Command (customer ops): ./redwoodctl scale --env finco-prod --pool gpu --count 6
2) Limit batching: set per-worker max_batch_size=8 and batch_timeout_ms=15 to avoid large tail batches.
   - Edit /etc/redwood/runtime.conf, restart runtime-worker (graceful): systemctl reload redwood-runtime
3) Temporarily pin model to a smaller variant (quantized int8) for user-facing routes to reduce mem pressure and OOMs while we investigate 500 path.
4) Collect targeted traces: enable runtime trace level "kernel:verbose" and capture a 5-minute ring buffer (we'll analyze). The perf_dump you provided is useful; please upload the raw ring buffer if possible.

Longer-term actions (post-mitigation):
- Patch runtime to add guard rails for long-sequence requests and to hard-fail vs bubble 500s to avoid cascade.
- Add autoscaling policy by request_size and queue_latency to avoid future manual scaling.

I'll start drafting an RCA timeline and gather a small team to do a deeper kernel/profiler analysis. For now, please confirm when customer is ready for scaling actions.

-Markus
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Alicia / Tom — final status update from our side. Thank you for running the scaling steps and sharing the perf dumps.

What we changed (deployed by FinCo ops with Redwood guidance):
- Node pool scaled 4 -> 6 (same instance type).
- max_batch_size lowered to 8, batch_timeout_ms = 15.
- Model pinned to quantized int8 variant for the user-facing route during the incident window.
- Collected kernel traces and a 5-minute ring buffer; engineering has started analysis.

Observed results (post-mitigation):
- p50 latency: ~70ms; p95: ~120-200ms (substantial improvement).
- 5xx error rate: down from ~7% -> ~0.6% over the 6-hour window post-mitigation.
- Throughput: returned to ~92% of baseline.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Engineering to deliver RCA and permanent runtime patch for the kernel handoff path — ETA 72 hours (Markus).
- Product + Engineering to propose autoscaling policy and recommended private deployment config (Monica / Markus) — ETA 5 business days.
- Exec comms: Vivek to review and send a brief note to FinCo CIO with our apology and the remediation/credit offer.

Alicia — please confirm if metrics on your side match these observations. We will prepare a short postmortem (postmortem_20260304.pdf) and a consolidated perf report at the link sent above.

Thanks again for working with us during this — we know outages like this are disruptive and we're treating follow-up as the top priority.

Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Customer Escalations
